clauses.reason: Terminated by Executive Order 12553, signed February 25, 1986, which orders that the listed Executive Orders, and any amendments thereto, are revoked, with no stated delayed effective date and no saving clause; the effective date is therefore the signing date, 1986-02-25. The table of revoked orders in the held text of Executive Order 12553 lists number 10029 with the subject "Creating an emergency board to investigate an airline labor dispute". This order created a board of three members to investigate the dispute between Northwest Airlines, Inc., and certain of its employees, barred interested members, required a report within thirty days of January 19, 1949 (due by February 18, 1949), and froze changes in conditions from that date until thirty days after the report. Under the owner ruling of 2026-10-21 on report deadlines, the report deadline and the end of the standstill are spent facts, functionally spent after the board reported and the standstill ran, and they are not the end; the order remained on the books until this express revocation.

savings.reason: No saving or transition provision appears in the held text of Executive Order 12553; the order's one-time commands were performed or lapsed, and the statute it applied (Railway Labor Act section 10) continues independently without needing this order.
